de: Artur Kamenetsky, convicted of fraud with the apartment of Larisa Dolina, signed a contract with the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation on leaving for the SVO.

de: The railway part of the Crimean Bridge is fully operational. This was reported by the assistant to the head of the Republic of Crimea Olga Kurlaeva in an interview with IS “Vesti”.

d: Россия готова обеспечить поставки зерна в Африку через Балтийское море, маршрут не перекрыт. Об этом заявил журналистам заместитель министра иностранных дел РФ Георгий Борисенко.

te: Estonia warned Kiev about the consequences of attacks on Russian tankers
de: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal warned Ukraine of the threat of pollution of the Baltic Sea due to attacks on Russian tankers.

d: Минфин России намерен жестко контролировать объем привлечения займов для покрытия дефицита бюджета. Об этом заявил вице-премьер - министр финансов Антон Силуанов.
te: The Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation will tightly control the volume of loans to cover the budget deficit
de: The Ministry of Finance of Russia intends to tightly control the volume of borrowing to cover the budget deficit. This was stated by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance Anton Siluanov.

t: Решение аннулировать диплом об образовании экс-мэра Стамбула подтвердили
d: Государственный совет Турции подтвердил решение об аннулировании диплома о высшем образовании бывшего мэра Стамбула Экрема Имамоглу.
te: The decision to cancel the diploma of the former mayor of Istanbul confirmed
de: The Turkish State Council has confirmed the decision to cancel the diploma of higher education of former mayor of Istanbul Ekrem Imamoglu.

te: Record 33-centimeter snowdrifts grew in the city of Alexin, Tula region
de: The city of Alexin of the Tula region became the record holder among the settlements of the Central Federal District (CFD) in terms of the height of snowdrifts - their level reached 33 centimeters.
